### The God Who Restores Withered Things - The Crosswalk Devotional - April 3
Author: Deidre Braley
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/crosswalk-devo/the-god-who-restores-withered-things-the-crosswalk-devotional.html
Passage: 1 Kings 13:6
Points:
- King Jeroboam's withered hand showed God's judgment, while its immediate healing demonstrated God's desire to restore the wayward.
- God's miraculous reversal served as an intentional call for the idolatrous king to return to Him in obedience.
- People often pull away from God after falling into sin, mistakenly assuming He has rejected them or that they are beyond help.
- God does not cast believers aside after mistakes; He continually pursues them and offers wholeness.
- Rather than shrinking away in shame, those who have wandered are encouraged to turn back to the Lord for healing.
